purpose: Test custom metrics and genuinely additional college information on a broader, retrospective prospect population.
prior_inspection: 2023/2024/2025 movement cohorts previously inspected; all results retrospective development, not prospective confirmation.
population: Drafted Combine invitees from 2013 through 2024 with unambiguous PFR ID and draft-year match; no complete-case athletic filtering. Exclude K/P/LS. Undrafted invitees remain in source inventory but are not assigned zero NFL outcomes from unmatched IDs.
identity: Exact PFR IDs and draft years; exact ESPN crosswalk for college sources. Reject duplicate/ambiguous identities. No fuzzy name matching. College joins additionally require normalized exact source-name verification; ambiguous ESPN crosswalk identities excluded.
primary_target: log(1 + first-two-seasons regular-season offense+defense snap count). NFL opportunity/use, not pure ability or pressure efficiency. Zero only for valid drafted identity in audited complete seasons.
secondary_target: First-two-seasons PFR pressures per 100 defensive snaps among defensive-front players with observed advanced data. Not pass-rush win rate. Missing advanced rows remain unknown.
source_cutoff: College seasons strictly earlier than draft year; immutable birth date only. Do not use career totals, latest NFL body measurements, current NFL position, survival, injuries or post-draft stats as features.
outer_validation: Predict draft classes 2018 through 2024; training classes at most test_year-2 so two-season labels had matured by prospect draft time. Entire players separated.
inner_validation: Latest up to three feasible earlier chronological class splits with the same two-year maturity gap; all imputation, scaling, tuning and optional shrinkage fitted inside training.

regularization.selection: Select correction on chronological inner losses; zero preferred unless paired improvement exceeds one estimated standard error. No feature screening using outer outcomes.

custom_metrics: Fixed physical transformations, college production shares, efficiency, multi-season trajectory and opponent-strength adjustment, only when input definitions and coverage permit. Preserve missingness and source support.
uncertainty: Paired player bootstrap stratified by held-out class; class-specific losses and sign stability. Intervals conditional on fitted predictions; no claim of full-refit or selection coverage.
decision: New metrics earn scouting use only through repeated chronological improvement against broad raw and draft-control comparisons. Retain every failure and source exclusion. Do not tune another metric bank using these outcomes.
pre_evaluation_amendment: Source/schema audit identified that a 2015 cohort floor leaves insufficient matured chronological inner splits for the 2018 outer test. Added exactly matched 2013/2014 training prospects before running any outcome evaluation; their unavailable college features stay missing.
model_scope: Custom model is a shrinkage mixture of separately tuned raw and augmented ridge predictions; zero exactly preserves raw. Each inner endpoint tunes on still-earlier matured classes when available; otherwise uses fixed alpha 100.
source_availability_controls: Before evaluating models, source audit identified that NFL-maintained crosswalk completeness and sparse old defensive rows could encode selection. Add combine+college-availability-only comparison and repeat the fixed model bank on name-verified college-linked players. These controls diagnose selection artifacts; they do not turn retrospective sources into prospective information.
post_initial_guard_amendment: After retaining evaluation_initial.json, diagnosed extreme raw-model extrapolation (2018 maximum predicted log snaps 37.25). Freeze source-only guard: mask numeric columns with fewer than max(20,10% of training rows) finite observations; clip standardized incoming values to training 1st/99th percentiles. Apply to every model, preserve the exact feature/penalty bank, no new outcome-screened metric. Guarded run is adaptive retrospective development, not independent confirmation.
